title: Which ZPA services the Go and Python SDKs cover differently, and the Go packages behind Python-only module names

prose.text: The Go and Python SDKs split ZPA differently, and the split is by package layout more often than by API coverage. The module and package inventory itself is generated.

prose.label: Policy groups.
prose.text: {{policy-group-python-ops}} [[zpa.sdk-python.policy-groups:unified-only]] The route differences from Go are in [[zpa.b2b-federation.sdk-contract:policy-group-routes]].

prose.label: Python modules with renamed Go packages.
Federation and Browser Access Groups.
prose.text: The new Go packages and their Python counterparts are held in [[zpa.b2b-federation.sdk-contract:go-covers-two-routes]], [[zpa.b2b-federation.sdk-contract:python-covers-partial]] and [[zpa.browser-access.tooling:go-browser-access-groups]].

checks.do: Before calling a service Go-only or Python-only, the other SDK's package list, since the tag services exist in both.
For SCIM user provisioning, that only the Go SDK has the calls, and they go to a separate SCIM client addressed by IdP ID.
For policy groups from Python, that the controllers exist only on the unified client.
Whether a Go-parity question for the ZIA customer config, user portal AUP or workload tag group used the Go package names, not the Python module names.

scim-users-go.statement: The Go SDK has SCIM user get, create, update, delete and list calls on a separate SCIM client addressed by IdP ID, while the Python ZPA service exposes SCIM groups and SCIM attributes properties.

quotes: func DeleteUser(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.ScimZPAService, userID string)
func UpdateUser(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.ScimZPAService, userID string, scimUser *ScimUser)

tags-in-both.statement: Tag keys and tag namespaces are in both SDKs: the Go SDK has tag_key and tag_namespace packages under tag_controller with /tagKey and /namespace routes, and the Python ZPA service has tag_key and tag_namespace properties.

pra-cbi-layout.statement: The Go SDK nests PRA and CBI services in privilegedremoteaccess and cloudbrowserisolation package trees; the PRA portal and CBI region services use the same routes as the Python pra_portal and cbi_region modules.

policy-group-python-ops.statement: Python's policy_group controller adds, lists (group/all), searches, gets, updates, deletes and reorders groups under /policyGroupSet/{group_set_id}/group, policy_group_rule lists, adds, gets, deletes and reorders rules under a group, and policy_group_set lists sets and reads them by ID or policy type, with summaries.

go-custom-config.statement: The Go package `custom_config_controller` covers the Python ZIA customer config routes: GET `/config/isZiaCloudConfigAvailable`, GET and POST `/config/ziaCloudConfig`, and GET and PUT `/config/sessionTerminationOnReauth`.

go-aup.statement: The Go package `userportal/aup` defines `Get`, `GetByName`, `Create`, `Update`, `Delete` and `GetAll` on `/userportal/aup`.

quotes: func Get(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, aupID string)
func GetByName(ctx context.Context, service *zscaler.Service, userPortalName string)

go-admin-sso.statement: The Go package `admin_sso_controller` updates the login options with POST on `/v2/ssoLoginOptions`.
